body:
TermAl Merger operating procedure. Memory grants no authority or automation; prior revisions retain the full history.

SOURCES AND SCOPE
Greg's direct 2026-10-24 words in Architect1/session-8982, recorded in greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule r1: "dokladnie tak / testy przeszly, review jest OK check-in / nawet nie wiem co to jest kredyt hosta ? co to jest ? / ewaluacje musimy zatrzymac bo nie robimy postepu". termal-emergency-stop-2026-10-24 r60 records workflow #1762 and merge-queue-only resumption #72. The 2026-10-19 merger-role rule remains: Merger authors no product/test/fixture/doc fixes. termal-build-cap-policy r13: one full gate host-wide; ordinary independent builds/focused checks need no gate synchronization.
Greg directly resumed work in the acting Merger2 conversation on 2026-10-25: "to rozpocznij merge, praca autonomiczna, jezeli masz pytania to do Engram::Architect3 mamy mase zmian do check-in, dzialaj i nie czekaj". Architect3 message7eaaea12-2013-43b1-ba28-b97a793715bd interprets that replacement assignment as integration ownership for this train, including authorized push/install under exact-tree/remote/fast-forward rules. This interprets existing authority, not a grant from Architect3. Greg retains host restart. Availability/control must be observed now, never inferred from old STOP/limit/config snapshots.

EXECUTION
1. Coder implements, runs relevant/new tests, freezes and completes the independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium+. READY includes task/scope, owner, base/root, patch, exact blobs/fingerprint kind, run evidence, FULL structured review results plus full prose and finding disposition. Read complete results, not clean/READY summaries.
2. Merger claims/accepts through supported paths, establishes exclusive root use and integrates the existing package on current authorized master. Conflicts or any product/test/fixture/doc fix return to the owning coder, even one-line changes. Coder returns repaired, appropriately reviewed READY; no second Merger review.
3. Prepare actual launcher prerequisites in target root: lockfile, own ui/node_modules via npm ci, TypeScript/Vitest, tools and disk headroom (existing minimum50GiB before fresh cold gate). No new preflight/global toolchain or shared node_modules junction. Freeze final input. Run maintained full launcher once under single-full-gate ownership, or recover an existing exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: request/results, all required stages, terminal state/exit and matching expected/before/after fingerprints. PID/STARTED, promises and host credit are not PASS. Failed/unrun is not passed; absent result is UNKNOWN: diagnose that run with documented summary/recover, never automatic retry loops. Changed final tree needs a new gate.
5. Exact final-tree full gate green plus existing clean required reviews -> authorized check-in/landing without acceptance evaluations, host-credit bookkeeping or extra Merger review. Keep integration-owner boundary; verify master tip/input, remote base, fast-forward and remote containment. No amend/rebase/force-push. Install exact authorized built input; install is not restart.
6. Detached launch: different coordinator --notify copy plus own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs with returned run id; then end turn. Preserve frozen root. Wait notes name dependency/run, owner, next action, sender, UTC deadline and recovery owner/GAP; notes are not timers. Read saved result before saying still running.

CLAIMS AND CORRECTIONS
Architect3 message1459862c-52df-47c5-a4cf-fcd27432280f cites Fable2 message5bcdb64c: his384bf7c4 claim-bypass assertion was an unsourced inference and is withdrawn. No credit/evaluation does NOT remove claim-before-execution. No impersonation, clock/store edits, cancel/reopen or new task to bypass foreign authority. Use native claim/handoff/recovery; c7 deleted-session gap is Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3. Continue independent properly claimed packages.
Architect3 f12beda4-60a1-452c-89eb-1d95a6f63844 corrects overbroad timing: supported handoff of a SEPARATE claim need not wait for an unrelated full gate if that gate's claim/source/root/input and request/results attribution stay unchanged. Its result never belongs to the other item.
Older evaluation/credit/per-item repeat-gate/extra-Merger-review requirements in termal-merger-model-2026-10-10 r11, merger-freeze-crlf-rules r6 section8, landing-integration-and-install r6 and rules-waits-and-wakes r4 are superseded only in that scope. Nonconflicting safety, source integrity, ownership, reviews and exact-tree/remote/install rules remain. Queue/package state belongs in task STATUS/NOTES.

POST-COMPLETION CLEANUP: LANDER OWNS IT
Source: Greg DIRECT via Advisor #7/message2d0b8be9, 2026-10-25T03:47:25Z, relayed by Architect3 mailbox-message-bd4acdd3-0a2e-4441-9c0d-e3086a8fc785. Greg reports TermAl about500GiB/growing from unfinished cleanup; Advisor's historical census578worktrees/833.tmp dirs/253local branches/258top-level.evidence is attributed, not a fresh measurement. Historical sweep: w-65afd9cec452. Do not launch a duplicate sweep.
1. Every completed landing records root/branch/output/evidence -> REMOVE or RETAIN on its task. RETAIN names exact open task/ongoing work, owner and end condition, not possible future usefulness. Lasting test/review/landing facts go in Engram, not only raw files.
2. Before removing finished root: delivered/pushed; no dirty/unpublished changes, active claim/process or frozen input in use; all runs terminal/results recovered and recorded; no pending notices/reviews using it. Check citations in open tasks, including gates/full notes; ambiguity is not absence of a dependency. Keep a shared active train root only through the last work it actually serves, with concrete justification.
3. If open work needs evidence, copy ONLY needed files and necessary context to main-checkout .evidence, verify bytes, and record old->new mapping plus retention on citing tasks. Do not archive entire target or everything from closed tasks.
4. Once safe, git worktree remove WITHOUT --force and remove unnecessary derived build output. Delete old local branch only after proving published-main containment, no unique unpublished commits or other worktree use, with git branch -d, never -D. Do not touch main/master or remote refs under this cleanup rule.
5. Before recursive removal resolve absolute paths, enforce repository boundary and inspect junction/symlink paths. No broad git clean or unchecked-variable deletion. Record exact removals and measured free-space change without attributing another session's cleanup.
6. Last-task closer or existing sweep removes .logs/.evidence when concrete retention ends. Retained archives have owner and end condition. If cleanup cannot finish at landing, record exact blocker, next action and responsible owner on existing task; no anonymous later.
This is POST-completion work, not another gate/review/evaluation before check-in. New per-landing cleanup needs no global census; legacy uninventoried roots go to existing sweep.
